label: Pure-act root and finite concrete ancestry yield immutability of every GOD_4 (inference)
rule: Identify the pure-act actual root by finite grounding reach, then transport the no-potency property
meaning: The same-witness bundle supplies an actual root n with no potency in any supplied respect. Each g satisfying the supplied GOD_4 predicate reaches n by the open finite-grounding-ancestry premise on the same profile m and selected world w. Any nonempty path would end in an incoming actual concrete grounding edge to n, so namedRootOfReach identifies g with n. Transport the no-potency conjunct along that equality using the same independently supplied InPotency predicate; IsImmutable uses this very PureAct body. An adopted application can instantiate both occurrences with the same adopted predicate. The proof uses only the actual-root and pure-act conjuncts of the existing bundle. The other conjuncts grant no premise about the identity or existence of a named God. The Comparator companion uses the existing plurality profile under its explicit excluded-middle hypothesis and names only the instrument, which is in potency as to drive when InPotency is instantiated with moved. The pure-act root bundle holds there, while finite reach and immutability of the named bearer fail. This tests the omission of the finite reach premise on that interpretation.
